description: The `Schema & Validation` component is fundamental to maintaining data integrity across the system. It explicitly defines the data structures for `Child Actions` and provides the validation rules that the `API Layer` enforces on all incoming data. This data, often originating from the `Client Layer`, is rigorously checked against these schemas to ensure consistency and prevent errors, forming a robust foundation for reliable application operation.

components.name: Schema & Validation
components.description: This is the core component responsible for defining type-safe data schemas using Zod and performing data validation. It acts as a single source of truth for data structures, ensuring consistency and integrity for API inputs, frontend forms, and internal data handling.
